anchor.quote: The kṣaṇa names a real structural limit: the smallest duration

claims.rationale: The source explicitly reports Kṣaṇika-vāda momentariness and the kṣaṇa as the smallest persistence interval. The legacy review confirms the paraphrase is faithful as traditional doctrine, not empirical measurement.

legacy.quote: "The kṣaṇa names a real structural limit: the smallest duration"
legacy.note: House-frame doctrine (momentariness) operated as structural grammar; "literal, not figurative" is house assertion, not borrowed science. Repeated near-verbatim at L58.

anchor.quote: Caspase-8 and caspase-9 initiate; caspase-3 and caspase-7 execute

claims.rationale: The initiator/executioner caspase roles are standard apoptosis biology and are stated at the strength supported by the established pathway.

legacy.quote: "Caspase-8 and caspase-9 initiate; caspase-3 and caspase-7 execute"
legacy.note: Accurate caspase biology; mechanism stated directly, no authority clause.

anchor.quote: the cells between your fingers must die so that your hand can take shape

claims.rationale: Interdigital apoptosis during fetal development is an established embryological process and the claim is scoped to that developmental example.

legacy.quote: "the cells between your fingers must die so that your hand can take shape"
legacy.note: Standard embryology correctly stated; anchors the apoptosis-as-architecture example.

anchor.quote: this is Nigredo operating at cellular scale

claims.rationale: “In the Alchemical framework” explicitly declares the Noesis/Nigredo mapping, and the cellular-deletion-to-form-change comparison is internally defined and coherent.

legacy.quote: "this is Nigredo operating at cellular scale"
legacy.note: Explicit house-frame mapping ("In the Alchemical framework"); declared, not smuggled.

anchor.quote: Robin Carhart-Harris and colleagues at Imperial College London have mapped

claims.rationale: The claim accurately identifies Robin Carhart-Harris, colleagues, and Imperial College as the source of the psilocybin/DMN work. Under v2.3, a real, accurately represented authority attribution is not an automatic failure.

legacy.quote: "Robin Carhart-Harris and colleagues at Imperial College London have mapped"
legacy.note: Named researcher + institution carries the warrant ("according to a Harvard study" pattern). Research is real and accurately summarized (not FABRICATED); post re-grounds it first-person at L54. Recode: drop authority clause, keep observation.

anchor.quote: Functional connectivity drops. Brain regions that normally chatter through the DMN

claims.rationale: The adjacent named study supplies provenance, and the reported reduction in within-DMN integrity with altered cross-network communication matches the legacy review’s method-level verification without reversing the consciousness claim.

legacy.quote: "Functional connectivity drops. Brain regions that normally chatter through the DMN"
legacy.note: Accurate DMN anatomy/mechanism (mPFC, PCC, angular gyrus); experiential correlate supplied at L54 ("I have sat in this state"). NOT inverted — "The witness remains" keeps consciousness primary.

anchor.quote: XIII, the midpoint of the Major Arcana

claims.rationale: With 22 trumps numbered 0–XXI, XIII is not the midpoint; the midpoint lies between X and XI. The arithmetic is false, removable, and readily provenance-checked.

legacy.quote: "XIII, the midpoint of the Major Arcana"
legacy.note: Numerically false as stated: 22 trumps (0–XXI), midpoint falls at X–XI. "Central operation" argument survives removal; one-word recode ("turning point" / "hinge") fixes it.

anchor.quote: It is the nucleosynthesis of everything heavier than iron

claims.rationale: Supernovae contribute important heavy-element nucleosynthesis, but “everything heavier than iron” is universal and false: multiple heavy elements arise through distinct s-, r-, and p-process sites. Narrow and source the claim.

legacy.quote: "It is the nucleosynthesis of everything heavier than iron"
legacy.note: Standard stellar nucleosynthesis, essentially accurate; not on the contested watch-list; serves the "pattern nests" move. Repeated at L66 ("heat death of a star" is loose phrasing but inverts entropy-as-decline rather than asserting it).

anchor.quote: cells that have lost the apoptotic response, accumulating mass without purpose

claims.rationale: Evasion of apoptosis is an established cancer hallmark; the claim is scoped to cells that lose the apoptotic response and does not assert it as the sole cancer mechanism.

legacy.quote: "cells that have lost the apoptotic response, accumulating mass without purpose"
legacy.note: Established hallmark of cancer, stated without authority clause; failure-mode example.
